property_summary: When the contract is not deployed as a proxy (i.e., address(this) == __self), the reference proxiableUUID() returns the implementation slot, while the buggy version reverts; calling acceptOwnership() on a non-delegated instance triggers the reverted path in the buggy version, causing a revert difference.
